faq.title: Menu, Ordering & Visiting FAQs | Easy Joy NYC
faq.description: Find answers about Easy Joy's location, menu prices, online ordering, hot pot soup bases and dining information before visiting Chinatown.

faqs.question: Where is Easy Joy located?
faqs.answer: Easy Joy is at 145 Mulberry St, New York, NY 10013, in Manhattan's Chinatown.

faqs.question: How much is all-you-can-eat hot pot at Easy Joy?
faqs.answer: All-you-can-eat hot pot is $28 per person every day, Monday to Sunday, before 5 PM. That price also includes 4–6 kinds of dim sum from the daily rotating dim sum cart. After 5 PM, all-you-can-eat hot pot is $43 per person. All-you-can-eat covers the hot pot only: the rest of the dim sum menu and all BBQ skewers are ordered à la carte, at lunch and at dinner. Tax and tip are extra. Prices can change, so call the restaurant to confirm before you visit.

faqs.question: What is on the Easy Joy menu?
faqs.answer: The online menu includes premium dim sum, buns and dumplings, rice noodle rolls, BBQ, fried rice and noodles, mini hot pots, malatang, hot pot ingredients, soup bases and more.

faqs.question: Can I order online for pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Order pickup online from the restaurant's ordering page, which shows the current menu, pickup times and checkout.

faqs.question: Can I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reserve on Yelp or from the Reserve a table button on Google Maps. Same-day tables can be booked up to 3 hours ahead; for larger groups, call the restaurant.

faqs.question: Does Easy Joy deliver?
faqs.answer: Yes. Order delivery on DoorDash, Uber Eats or Grubhub, or order pickup online directly from the restaurant.

faqs.question: Does Easy Joy cater office lunches and events?
faqs.answer: Yes. Easy Joy takes catering orders on ezCater for dim sum, skewers and more. Place catering orders at least 24 hours ahead; ezCater shows the current minimum order and delivery fee.

faqs.question: Are the menu prices on this website all-you-can-eat prices?
faqs.answer: No. Prices on this website come from the online pickup menu, including individual hot pot ingredients and soup bases. All-you-can-eat pricing is listed in the question above.

faqs.question: Which hot pot soup bases can I order for pickup?
faqs.answer: For pickup, you can order Rich Tomato Broth, Coconut Chicken Broth, Pork Bone Collagen Broth and Tom Yum Goong Soup, $9.99 each.

faqs.question: What are the current opening hours?
faqs.answer: Easy Joy is open Monday through Sunday, from 10:00 AM to 10:30 PM (New York local time).

faqs.question: How can I ask about allergies or dietary requirements?
faqs.answer: Call the restaurant before you order, and tell us about allergies when you visit. We'll check ingredients and preparation for each dish with you.
